items.title: Willie "Old Man" Parker Interview, 1958-11-07
items.q: Picked that name out of the man Ricka.

ctx.x: So, I get a job, $90, for liberty. And he arrived right now. He wasn't born then. He lived. Wasn't thought of. And I get this job and I pick out 11 men beside myself. 12 men to play that $90 job, you know? We had 35 men in the Garbage van, you know? So, the fellas I didn't pick out, they got committed, Captain Jones, and brought them to my house on a Friday. We went down there on the Central Rock Street. So, Captain Jones called me and said, well, Paola, I'll tell you all that job left for the first. I said, yes,…
What year was that about? Oh, I just remember now. Was it after World War I or before?
